hold_text: manager merges under the data-backed Tier-2/3 authority (audit brief evidence). Tier-2 because it changes the live trader's per-bar regime scoring path (src/runtime/regime_bar_scoring.py, whose advisory heads publish P(volatile) to the regime router via ml_vol_verdict), the signal-time shadow row (src/runtime/strategy_signal_builders.py), the live fc_* serve (src/runtime/forecast_live.py), a /api/bot/shadow/stats field, and the trainer's forecast timer. No order path, risk cap, strategy config or account mode is touched. Deploy after merge: restart ict-trader-live (scoring) and ict-web-api (/stats); run scripts/ops/install_trainer_publish_units.sh on the trainer via the trainer-vm-diag relay (the timer); the producer script itself arrives by the trainer's git-sync.
why: Code audit 2026-09-27, CA-B01, evidence-settled Tier-2 fixes FIX-CA-23/24/25 (docs/audits/code-audit-2026-09-27.md section 5; verdicts CONFIRMED in docs/audits/code-audit-2026-09-27/CA-LEAD.verdicts.json). FIX-CA-23 (PI-20260927-3WM5HADW-0006): emit_regime_bar_predictions scored every regime head and built xa_* on the still-forming Bybit bar while every market_features training row is closed; new shared src/runtime/closed_bars.drop_forming_bar (open_ts + tf > now) trims it before dedup key, closes, xa_* (target and peers) and fc rows, and at the signal-time shadow row. Test sensitivity checked: with the trim disabled the planted forming spike moves vol_bucket vol_b0 -> vol_b2. FIX-CA-24 (PI-20260927-3WM5HADW-0007): compute_live_forecast_row served a frozen artifact forever; it now takes the scored bar_ts and refuses (None + fc_stale counter) a forecast more than 1 bar behind or any bar ahead, persists per-symbol lag to runtime_logs/forecast_live_status.json and surfaces it as forecast_serve on /api/bot/shadow/stats (read_state observed / not_written / unreadable). DEVIATION FROM THE BRIEF, stated: the brief says refuse on any mismatch; exact equality would NaN-degrade the two advisory fc heads on nearly every bar because the producer forecasts a bar only after it closes and the mirror rsyncs up to 2 min later while the scorer scores at the close, so a 1-bar publication lag is accepted. The false comment in run_forecast_producer.sh is corrected. FIX-CA-25 (PI-20260927-3WM5HADW-0008): the producer forecast the forming bar; build_forecast_artifact now trims it so as_of_ts is the last closed bar, and ict-trainer-forecast.timer moves from OnUnitActiveSec=15min to OnCalendar=*:0/15:30 + AccuracySec=1s in both cloud-init and install_trainer_publish_units.sh (systemd-analyze calendar verified). Tests: every new test fails on main and passes here; 369 passed across the 34 test files importing a touched module.
